intro.h2: A remodeling company that grew out of the cabinet trade
paragraphs: Stevens Kitchens has offered kitchen remodeling in Oviedo, FL since 2003, and the company grew out of cabinets. Owner Steve Tedesco started in the late 1990s as a service technician for a kitchen cabinet company, then became an installer before opening his own business.

Today Stevens Kitchens is a licensed general contractor that handles design, labor, materials and permits for kitchens, bathrooms and custom cabinetry. Designers draw your room in 3D, field supervisors and licensed subcontractors build it, and a BuilderTrend calendar lets you check the schedule any time. Reviewers thank designer Reem and assistant field supervisor Dylan by name.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Oviedo, FL, plus baths and custom cabinetry

items.name: Full Kitchen Remodels
items.blurb: Demolition, drywall and framing, electrical, plumbing, flooring, tile, backsplash, countertops, fixtures and hardware handled by one licensed contractor. Full kitchen remodels start at about $35,000, and a typical project takes six to eight weeks, with every date visible in your BuilderTrend calendar.

image.alt: Remodeled kitchen with white cabinets, a navy island with white quartz top, blue glass pendants and a chevron tile backsplash

items.name: Cabinet Sales and Installation
items.blurb: Cabinets are where Steve started, and you can buy them the way that suits you: cabinets only, cabinets and countertops with installation, or as part of a partial or full remodel. A designer meets you in the showroom to plan the layout, door style and finish.

image.alt: Kitchen with black shaker cabinets to the ceiling, glass-front uppers, a marble slab backsplash and stainless range hood

items.name: Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: Master and guest baths with new cabinets and countertops, tile, flooring, plumbing, electrical, fixtures and hardware. Master bathroom remodels start at about $35,000. Google reviewers mention master bath redos and say it was a pleasure to work with the same professional subcontractors again.

image.alt: Master bathroom with a freestanding tub, marble-look slab walls and a frameless glass walk-in shower

items.name: Laundry Rooms and Custom Cabinetry
items.blurb: Pantries, wet bars, mudrooms, coffee stations, entertainment centers, home offices and laundry rooms built with the same cabinetry know-how as the kitchens. Laundry rooms and other smaller projects typically run about $15,000 to $22,000, depending on size and materials.

about.h2: Meet Steve Tedesco, owner and designer
about.text: Steve Tedesco learned the business from the inside of a cabinet box. In the late 1990s he was a service technician for a kitchen cabinet company, which led to work as an installer. In 2003, still installing, he opened Stevens Kitchens Inc. Two years later the first showroom opened for browsing, and after earning his general contractor license in 2015, Steve opened the current showroom on Broadway Street in Oviedo. He still works as owner and designer, alongside designer Reem Kader, field supervisor and production manager Jose Torres, assistant field supervisor Dylan White and project coordinator Joshua Martin.

image.alt: Steve Tedesco, owner and designer of Stevens Kitchens in Oviedo, FL

process.h2: How your Stevens Kitchens project gets started

steps.title: Share photos of your space
steps.text: Before your consultation, the designer asks for photos and details of the room so the first meeting starts with real ideas.

steps.title: Showroom consultation
steps.text: Meet a designer in the Oviedo showroom for 30 minutes to an hour, talk through plans and goals, and get an estimated cost right away.

steps.title: See it in 3D
steps.text: Your designer brings the project to life with three-dimensional renderings of the improved space, so you can judge the layout before committing.

steps.title: In-home measure and estimate
steps.text: Schedule an in-home measure with your designer and receive a preliminary estimate. Then the selections begin.

steps.title: Build and track
steps.text: Field supervisors and licensed subcontractors complete the work, usually in six to eight weeks, while you follow the full calendar in BuilderTrend.

service_area.h2: Based in Oviedo, working across Central Florida
service_area.text: Stevens Kitchens works from its showroom at 1399 W Broadway St in Oviedo, and the company describes itself as a household name across Central Florida. Its site does not publish a town-by-town service list, so call (407) 359-0302 with your address and the office will confirm whether your home is in range. Showroom hours run Monday through Saturday, so you can stop in and see cabinet finishes in person.

faq.h2: What Oviedo homeowners ask before they remodel

items.q: What does a kitchen remodel cost?
items.a: Costs depend on size, materials and labor. Full kitchen and master bathroom remodels start at about $35,000, while laundry rooms and other smaller projects typically run about $15,000 to $22,000. Your designer can give you an estimated cost at the first showroom consultation and a preliminary estimate after the in-home measure.

items.q: How long does a remodel take?
items.a: A typical project runs six to eight weeks, and timelines can stretch or shorten depending on progress. You see it all: Stevens Kitchens uses BuilderTrend, which gives you access to your full project calendar at any time, so you always know what is coming next.

Yes. The company uses a payment plan that spans the length of your project, and it also offers financing options through multiple financial institutions. Ask your designer about current options, or call the office at (407) 359-0302 and the team will explain what is available.

items.q: How long is the showroom consultation?
items.a: In-office consultations with a designer last from 30 minutes to over an hour, depending on the size of your project and how many rooms you want to tackle. Sending photos of the space beforehand lets the designer prepare three-dimensional renderings for you to review.

items.q: Can I buy cabinets without a full remodel?
items.a: Yes. When you request a consultation you can choose a full remodel, a partial remodel, cabinets and countertops with installation, or a cabinet sale only. That flexibility comes from the company's roots: Steve started in the cabinet trade as a service technician and installer before opening Stevens Kitchens.

final_cta.text: Call (407) 359-0302 or schedule a consultation. The showroom is open Monday to Thursday 9am to 5pm, Friday 9am to 4pm and Saturday 9am to 2pm.
